business: AITechnician (working name): voice-to-service-report software for AC and appliance service shops
target: Owners of AC, appliance, generator and electrical service companies in Chennai with 5 to 50 field technicians (all money figures here are Indian rupees, not dollars)

segments.name: Owner of a small shop, 5 to 10 technicians (income in rupees)
Owner of a mid-sized firm, 11 to 25 technicians (income in rupees)
Owner of a larger firm, 26 to 50 technicians, with an office coordinator (income in rupees)

behaviours.name: Runs everything on WhatsApp
behaviours.how: Customers message you, you forward jobs to a technicians' WhatsApp group, and photos and updates come back by chat.

behaviours.name: Price-first
behaviours.how: Uses free tools wherever possible and compares every paid tool with the cheapest one you have heard of.

behaviours.name: Tried an app before
behaviours.how: Paid for a job-tracking app once; the technicians stopped using it within weeks and you went back to calls and WhatsApp.

behaviours.name: Buys on recommendation
behaviours.how: Only tries something a trusted fellow owner, distributor or relative already uses.

behaviours.name: Brand service partner
behaviours.how: Does authorised service for one or two AC brands, which make you log their jobs in the brand's own system; your own customers are tracked separately.

behaviours.name: Does the paperwork at night
behaviours.how: Spends evenings calling technicians and writing up job details, bills and AMC dates yourself.

objections: My technicians will not use an app; they barely read English
WhatsApp is free and it works well enough
Will it really understand Tamil and Tanglish on a noisy rooftop?
Other job apps cost about ₹99 per technician; why pay more?
Who is behind this? Will it still be around next year?
I have no time to set up new software during the summer rush
Is my customer list safe with you?
habits: your technicians leave by 9am and you phone each one through the day to know where things stand
April to June is the AC rush, and you turn away jobs
a big part of your steady income is AMC contracts with apartments and offices
customers sometimes dispute what was done or which part was changed
you keep job and AMC records in a notebook and on WhatsApp
